answer: Anyone running 195 aliases as a result needs 60 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in jade, expire in jetty, and delta lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4773 identities would post 2921 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
